newsitem.title: GERMANY: MLP plans to raise capital by 3 mln marks.
newsitem.headline: MLP plans to raise capital by 3 mln marks.

text.p: German financial services group Marschollek, Lautenschlager und Partner AG (MLP) said on Thursday it planned to raise its base capital by three million marks to 33 million marks.
The company said it was taking full advantage of an allowance approved by shareholders in July to raise its capital by up to three million marks.
The company is to issue 300,000 common shares and 300,000 preferred shares with nominal value of five marks each.
The shares will carry full dividend right for the 1996 business year. More details will be given at the end of October.
